column2: The check-in desk for our flight is in Zone B.
column3: 我们航班的值机柜台在B区。

column2: How much luggage can I take?
column3: 我可以带多少行李？

column2: I need to check a bag, but my backpack is carry-on.
column3: 我需要托运一个包，背包随身带。

column2: I prefer an aisle seat on long flights.
column3: 长途飞行我更喜欢靠过道的座位。

column2: Boarding time is 10:40, so don't be late.
column3: 登机时间是十点四十，别迟到。

column2: Check the departure board for your gate.
column3: 看看出发信息屏上你的登机口。

column2: Please be careful. This box is fragile.
column3: 请小心，这个箱子是易碎的。

column2: Put a name label on your suitcase.
column3: 在你的行李箱上贴一个姓名标签。

column2: I have my e-ticket on my phone.
column3: 我的电子机票在手机上。

column2: What is your final destination?
column3: 您的最终目的地是哪里？

column2: Our flight is delayed by an hour.
column3: 我们的航班延误了一个小时。

column2: The queue for the security check is very long.
column3: 安检的队伍很长。

column2: You have to throw away your drink before security.
column3: 过安检前你得把饮料扔掉。

column2: Please go to the boarding gate thirty minutes before departure.
column3: 请在起飞前三十分钟到登机口。

column2: Listen! There's an announcement about our flight.
column3: 听！有一条关于我们航班的广播。

column2: This is the final call for flight BA 168 to London.
column3: 这是飞往伦敦的BA168航班最后一次登机广播。

column2: My seat is in row 24.
column3: 我的座位在第24排。

column2: The flight attendant brought me some water.
column3: 空乘人员给我拿了些水。

column2: The crew will serve dinner soon.
column3: 机组人员很快会供应晚餐。

column2: After you land, follow the signs to immigration.
column3: 落地后，跟着指示牌去入境检查处。

column2: The border officer asked me a few questions.
column3: 边检官员问了我几个问题。

column2: I need a student visa to study there for a year.
column3: 去那里学习一年需要学生签证。

column2: Please put your finger on the scanner for your fingerprint.
column3: 请把手指放在扫描仪上录指纹。

column2: We went through customs quickly.
column3: 我们很快就过了海关。

column2: Our bags will come out on carousel 5.
column3: 我们的行李会在5号转盘出来。

column2: Go to the lost luggage desk if your bag doesn't arrive.
column3: 如果你的包没到，去行李丢失柜台。

column2: My host family will wait for me in the arrivals hall.
column3: 我的寄宿家庭会在到达大厅等我。

column2: My host dad will pick me up at the airport.
column3: 我的寄宿爸爸会到机场接我。

column2: We'll arrive at six p.m. local time.
column3: 我们将在当地时间下午六点到达。

column2: It's my first time in a foreign country.
column3: 这是我第一次来外国。

column2: The currency in the UK is the pound.
column3: 英国的货币是英镑。

column2: Go to reception if you have a question.
column3: 有问题就去前台。

column2: The teacher takes the register every morning.
column3: 老师每天早上点名。

column2: My favourite subject is science.
column3: 我最喜欢的科目是科学。

column2: We have to wear a uniform at this school.
column3: 在这所学校我们必须穿校服。

column2: The library is in the main building.
column3: 图书馆在主楼里。

column2: Phones are not allowed in class. It's one of the school rules.
column3: 上课不能用手机，这是校规之一。

column2: Hurry up, or we'll be late for class!
column3: 快点，不然我们上课要迟到了！

column2: Can you show me around the school?
column3: 你能带我参观一下学校吗？

column2: Please put up your hand if you have a question.
column3: 有问题请举手。

column2: Please hand in your homework on Friday.
column3: 请在周五交作业。

column2: We do a lot of group work in English class.
column3: 我们在英语课上做很多小组活动。

column2: Sorry, I don't understand this question.
column3: 抱歉，我不理解这个问题。

column2: Could you speak more slowly, please?
column3: 您能说慢一点吗？

column2: The teacher wrote the new words on the whiteboard.
column3: 老师把生词写在了白板上。

column2: I have an appointment with my tutor at three.
column3: 我三点和导师有个约见。

column2: Bring a sick note from your doctor.
column3: 带上医生开的病假条。

column2: If you miss a class, ask a friend for the notes.
column3: 如果你缺了课，就找朋友借笔记。

column2: I got a good grade on my science test.
column3: 我科学测验得了个好成绩。

column2: Don't worry about making a mistake.
column3: 别担心犯错。

column2: Many students struggle with this grammar.
column3: 很多学生觉得这个语法很难。

column2: You can get extra help after school.
column3: 放学后你可以得到额外辅导。

column2: The end-of-term exam is in June.
column3: 期末考试在六月。

column2: I need to revise for my history test.
column3: 我需要为历史测验复习。

column2: You need your parents' permission to go on the trip.
column3: 参加这次旅行需要父母的许可。

column2: Our class is going on a trip to the museum.
column3: 我们班要去博物馆进行一次校外参观。

column2: Please ask your host parents to sign the consent form.
column3: 请让你的寄宿父母在同意书上签字。

column2: If you feel ill at school, go to the nurse.
column3: 如果在学校感到不舒服，就去找校医。

column2: I have a stomach ache after eating too fast.
column3: 我吃得太快，肚子疼。

column2: I have a runny nose and I keep sneezing.
column3: 我流鼻涕，还一直打喷嚏。

column2: I think I've caught a cold.
column3: 我觉得我感冒了。

column2: She has the flu, so she's staying in bed.
column3: 她得了流感，所以卧床休息。

column2: I have a pain in my right knee.
column3: 我的右膝盖疼。

column2: I felt so sick that I thought I would throw up.
column3: 我恶心得觉得要吐了。

column2: My ankle is swollen after the football match.
column3: 踢完足球比赛后我的脚踝肿了。

column2: A high temperature is a common symptom of flu.
column3: 发高烧是流感的常见症状。

column2: Cover your mouth when you sneeze.
column3: 打喷嚏时要捂住嘴。

column2: The doctor's surgery opens at eight thirty.
column3: 诊所八点半开门。

column2: If you feel ill, you should see your GP.
column3: 如果你不舒服，应该去看全科医生。

column2: The receptionist asked for my name and date of birth.
column3: 接待员问了我的姓名和出生日期。

column2: Please wait in the waiting room until the doctor calls you.
column3: 请在候诊室等候，医生会叫你。

column2: I go to the dentist for a check-up twice a year.
column3: 我一年去牙医那里检查两次。

column2: The doctor will examine your throat.
column3: 医生会检查你的喉咙。

column2: The nurse will take your temperature first.
column3: 护士会先给你量体温。

column2: The doctor wants me to have a blood test.
column3: 医生要我验个血。

column2: Do you have any allergies to food or medicine?
column3: 你对食物或药物过敏吗？

column2: Please fill in this form about your medical history.
column3: 请填写这张关于你病史的表格。

column2: International students need health insurance.
column3: 国际学生需要健康保险。

column2: You'll recover quickly if you rest.
column3: 你好好休息就会很快康复。

column2: There's a pharmacy next to the doctor's surgery.
column3: 诊所旁边有一家药店。

column2: Ask the pharmacist if you're not sure how to take it.
column3: 如果不确定怎么服用，就问药剂师。

column2: Take this medicine with a glass of water.
column3: 用一杯水送服这种药。

column2: She took a painkiller for her headache.
column3: 她吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。

column2: Swallow the capsule whole. Don't chew it.
column3: 整粒吞下胶囊，不要嚼。

column2: Take two spoons of cough syrup before bed.
column3: 睡前喝两勺止咳糖浆。

column2: Don't take more than the dose on the box.
column3: 服用量不要超过盒子上写的剂量。

column2: Don't take this medicine on an empty stomach.
column3: 不要空腹服用这种药。

column2: You can buy this medicine over the counter.
column3: 这种药不用处方就能买到。

column2: Put this cream on the rash twice a day.
column3: 这种药膏一天在皮疹处涂两次。

column2: Use sun cream to avoid sunburn.
column3: 用防晒霜避免晒伤。

column2: This cream is good for an insect bite.
column3: 这种药膏对虫咬很有效。

column2: Read the instructions on the box before you take it.
column3: 服用前请阅读盒子上的说明。

column2: Could we have a table for two, please?
column3: 请给我们一张两人桌好吗？

column2: I can put your name on the waiting list.
column3: 我可以把您的名字写在等候名单上。

column2: Would you like to sit inside or outside?
column3: 您想坐室内还是室外？

column2: It's sunny, so let's sit outside.
column3: 天气晴朗，我们坐外面吧。

column2: The host showed us to our table.
column3: 领位员把我们带到了座位上。

column2: The waiter brought our drinks.
column3: 服务员把我们的饮料端来了。

column2: The waitress was very friendly.
column3: 那位女服务员非常友好。

column2: Could we have a high chair for the baby?
column3: 可以给宝宝一把高脚椅吗？

column2: The restaurant is very busy on Friday nights.
column3: 这家餐厅周五晚上很忙。

column2: Could we have a quiet table, please?
column3: 我们可以要一张安静点的桌子吗？

column2: We sat at a table in the corner.
column3: 我们坐在角落的一张桌子旁。

column2: For a starter, I'll have the tomato soup.
column3: 前菜我要番茄汤。

column2: What would you like for your main course?
column3: 您主菜想吃什么？

column2: I'd like my steak medium, please.
column3: 我的牛排要五分熟，谢谢。

column2: The portions here are really big.
column3: 这里的份量真的很大。

column2: I'd like fried rice with vegetables.
column3: 我想要蔬菜炒饭。

column2: Could I have a bottle of still water?
column3: 请给我一瓶不含气的水好吗？

column2: I don't like sparkling water.
column3: 我不喜欢气泡水。

column2: This soup tastes amazing!
column3: 这汤尝起来太棒了！

column2: Could we have the check, please?
column3: 请给我们账单好吗？

column2: Can I pay in cash?
column3: 我可以用现金付款吗？

column2: A ten per cent service charge is added to the bill.
column3: 账单上加了百分之十的服务费。

column2: I think we got the wrong order.
column3: 我想我们的菜上错了。

column2: Excuse me, my soup is cold.
column3: 打扰一下，我的汤是凉的。

column2: If the food is bad, you can complain to the manager.
column3: 如果食物不好，你可以向经理投诉。

column2: Is this to eat in or take away?
column3: 这是在这里吃还是带走？

column2: The total is twenty-five pounds.
column3: 总共二十五英镑。

column2: Let me introduce my friend Lily.
column3: 我来介绍一下我的朋友莉莉。

column2: My hometown is famous for its food.
column3: 我的家乡以美食闻名。

column2: What grade are you in?
column3: 你上几年级？

column2: My hobby is taking photos.
column3: 我的爱好是拍照。

column2: I'm really into K-pop at the moment.
column3: 我最近特别迷韩国流行音乐。

column2: We have a lot in common. We both love cats.
column3: 我们有很多共同点，我们都喜欢猫。

column2: My classmate helped me with my homework.
column3: 我同学帮我做了作业。

column2: I was a bit shy on my first day.
column3: 第一天我有点害羞。

column2: Mia is very outgoing and talks to everyone.
column3: 米娅很外向，和谁都聊。

column2: We chatted about music at lunch.
column3: 我们午饭时聊了聊音乐。

column2: My nickname at school is "Em".
column3: 我在学校的昵称是"Em"。

column2: Sorry, I'm busy this weekend.
column3: 抱歉，这个周末我很忙。

column2: Thanks for inviting me to your party!
column3: 谢谢你邀请我参加你的派对！

column2: Let's go to the shopping centre on Saturday.
column3: 我们周六去购物中心吧。

column2: Can I go to Lily's sleepover on Friday?
column3: 我周五可以去莉莉家过夜吗？

column2: Let's meet up after school.
column3: 我们放学后碰个面吧。

column2: Can I suggest a different time?
column3: 我可以提议换个时间吗？

column2: My host mum can pick you up at five.
column3: 我的寄宿妈妈可以五点来接你。

column2: I need permission from my host parents.
column3: 我需要得到寄宿父母的许可。

column2: What's the plan for Saturday?
column3: 周六的计划是什么？

column2: What are you doing this weekend?
column3: 你这个周末做什么？

column2: I've already bought the cinema tickets.
column3: 我已经买好电影票了。

column2: I follow a lot of art accounts online.
column3: 我在网上关注了很多艺术账号。

column2: She left a nice comment on my drawing.
column3: 她在我的画下面留了一条好评。

column2: Check your privacy settings on every app.
column3: 检查每个应用的隐私设置。

column2: Always be kind when you write comments.
column3: 写评论时一定要友善。

column2: It's rude to ignore someone's message for days.
column3: 好几天不回别人的消息是不礼貌的。

column2: Sorry, I think you misunderstood me.
column3: 抱歉，我想你误解我了。

column2: I want to apologise for what I said.
column3: 我想为我说过的话道歉。

column2: I'm sorry. I didn't do it on purpose.
column3: 对不起，我不是故意的。

column2: Let's get a trolley. We have a lot to buy.
column3: 我们推一辆购物车吧，要买的东西很多。

column2: Frozen food is at the back of the shop.
column3: 冷冻食品在商店后面。

column2: The bread from the bakery is still warm.
column3: 烘焙区的面包还是热的。

column2: Fruit and vegetables are near the entrance.
column3: 果蔬区在入口附近。

column2: Don't buy too many snacks!
column3: 别买太多零食！

column2: Household items like soap are in aisle nine.
column3: 肥皂之类的家居用品在九号通道。

column2: I need to buy some shampoo.
column3: 我需要买点洗发水。

column2: Is this size in stock?
column3: 这个尺码有货吗？

column2: Sorry, the strawberries are sold out.
column3: 抱歉，草莓卖完了。

column2: Let me check in the storeroom for you.
column3: 我去仓库帮您看看。

column2: These pens are cheap but good.
column3: 这些笔又便宜又好用。

column2: This cheese is too expensive.
column3: 这个奶酪太贵了。

column2: Students get a ten per cent discount.
column3: 学生可以打九折。

column2: All the cakes are half price after six.
column3: 六点以后所有蛋糕半价。

column2: You get points every time you use your loyalty card.
column3: 每次使用会员卡都能获得积分。

column2: You can save money if you buy the big pack.
column3: 买大包装可以省钱。

column2: It's a bit expensive, but it's worth it.
column3: 有点贵，但很值得。

column2: There's a long queue at the checkout.
column3: 收银台排着长队。

column2: The self-checkout is faster.
column3: 自助结账更快。

column2: The cashier gave me my change.
column3: 收银员把零钱找给了我。

column2: Remember to bring your own bag to save money.
column3: 记得自带购物袋，可以省钱。

column2: Please enter your PIN.
column3: 请输入密码。

column2: Insert your card into the machine.
column3: 把卡插进机器里。

column2: The card machine is broken, so please pay in cash.
column3: 刷卡机坏了，请用现金付款。

column2: The machine needs approval from a member of staff.
column3: 机器需要工作人员确认。

column2: There's an age check for some items, like knives.
column3: 有些商品需要核查年龄，比如刀具。

column2: Please join the queue here.
column3: 请在这里排队。
